issues.problem: Selection makes nonselected field labels so faint that they are difficult to read while tracing the selected flow.
issues.fix: Keep the selected ribbon’s outline and dim the other ribbons, but retain enough contrast for all field labels to remain legible.

issues.problem: The mode-switch test confirms a visual update, but it does not verify the exact cross-field coverage or that every displayed link joins two different classified fields.
issues.fix: Extend the headless test to assert 4,490 of 10,264 citations shown at the top-25 cutoff and verify that all displayed links have two classified, different endpoints.

reviews.summary: The two-column Sankey clearly follows references from citing fields on the left to cited fields on the right. Ribbon width encodes distinct directed work-pair counts, and color distinguishes same-field from cross-field flows. The default view prominently reports the top 25 of 413 eligible links and 30,307 of 39,134 citations shown, making clear that the diagram is not exhaustive. The selection screenshot shows a clear highlight and an ordered field-pair tooltip with the raw count. Hover, selection, highlighting, and both host parameter updates passed the reported checks.
